profiles.notes: Model card: the API maps temperature 1.0 to 0.3 internally; for local serving use 0.3. V3.1 and later have their own parsers (vLLM deepseek_v31, SGLang deepseekv31); set local.profile or a user profile with those for V3.1+. Large MoE: usually served on another machine on the LAN.

Model card: temperature 0.5-0.7 (0.6 recommended), top_p 0.95, no system prompt, and earlier reasoning must not be sent back. Distills inherit the base model's (Qwen2.5 / Llama 3) template and were not trained for tool calls, so prompted mode.
